reported_claims.text: A maritime security centre logged position errors from multiple vessels.

title: DEMO: Satellite navigation interference reported over shipping lane
summary: DEMONSTRATION RECORD. Several commercial vessels reported GNSS position errors in a fictional shipping lane. The source of interference has not been identified.
impact_assessment: Potential: navigation hazards and delays in a busy lane.
priority_rationale: Moderate: reported but unverified interference without incidents so far.
monitoring_actions: Track maritime advisories for the lane
